stories.title: Henry Cejudo reflects on passing of Eddie Cha: ‘Master Cha, you will always be remembered’
stories.summary: Henry Cejudo is going to miss Eddie Cha. On Wednesday, Cha, the famed striking coach at Fight Ready in Glendale, Ariz., died suddenly of unknown causes. During his career, Cha worked with some of the biggest names in MMA, but arguably his most successful student is former UFC flyweight and bantamweight champion Henry Cejudo. Speaking […]
